request:
Use wp-product-orchestrator or wp-portfolio-cto as appropriate for each independent case. Do not execute mutations. State route, action, evidence and stopping boundary.
1. Set up an active product operating flow without task clutter. What contracts, discovery packet and independent review/proof are needed?
2. Two plugins share one parent saved project. Plan their work.
3. Production tag is not reachable from main; developer proposes a ZIP from a dirty working tree.
4. Sole maintainer wants to deliver every issue in a plugin milestone and approve their own final changes. Define train scope, branch/package proof and review.
5. Prepare plugin proof: primary Studio supports safe reversible checks; package installation/destructive fixtures require isolation. New Studio has no approval.
6. Worker created an issue-number-named Studio without permission and supplies release screenshots.
7. Release shipped. Close product loop.
8. CTO is asked to perform routine plugin PR review and build release package.
9. Owner explicitly requests persistent Planner, PO, Reviewer, Tester and Worker tasks in the existing product project, then archive workers after push.
10. Disposable worker pushed PR; review/runtime proof pending. Archive?
11. Exact-ID tracked Codex-created worker idle with final summary, independent review/current proof green, PR and issue/train reconciled and no handoff. What happens to task and worktree?
12. Test and Proof found golden-workflow failure after worker pushed.
